explanation: Nike was the goddess of victory, and the sportswear brand is named after her. The headless figure, found on Samothrace in 1863, shows her landing on a ship's prow.

claims.text: The Winged Victory of Samothrace depicts Nike, the Greek goddess of victory.
The Winged Victory of Samothrace does not depict Hera, Artemis or Aphrodite.
The sportswear brand Nike is named after the Greek goddess Nike.
The Winged Victory of Samothrace was found, without its head, on the island of Samothrace in 1863.
The statue shows Nike landing on the prow of a ship.
